evidence: Presence of urls.py and wsgi.py files is characteristic of Django, which follows the MVC pattern (though Django calls it MTV, it is functionally equivalent to MVC)
Herokufreeproxy directory structure mirrors Django's default project layout with settings.py, __init__.py, urls.py, wsgi.py
Single package with limited depth (2 levels) indicates a monolithic structure with clear separation of concerns (configuration, routing, deployment)
Use of 'admin' and 'views' imports in urls.py confirms typical Django MVC-style routing and view handling
Django WhiteNoise integration in wsgi.py is common for Django MVC applications deployed on Heroku
risks: Tight coupling between layers is possible due to Django's integrated design (e.g., views directly accessing models)
Scalability limitations due to monolithic deployment (shared process/memory)
缺乏 clear domain boundaries or separate modules for business logic and infrastructure
